institutions.history: University College TATI (UC TATI), formerly known as Terengganu Advanced Technical Institute (TATI), was established on 11th June 1993 through a collaborative effort between the State Government of Terengganu and Ingenieurschule St. Gallen, Switzerland. From its inception, UC TATI has been dedicated to cultivating highly skilled technocrats in cutting-edge engineering disciplines and fostering top-tier talent for the workforce. A significant milestone in its journey occurred when UC TATI was officially recognized as a University College, cementing its commitment to excellence. On 17th September 2019, the Department of Higher Education (Malaysia) approved the institution's rebranding as University College TATI (UC TATI), marking a new chapter in its history. Since 1993, UC TATI has remained steadfast in its pursuit of global eminence, striving to produce well-rounded and industry-ready graduates.
